notes: CONFIRMED per user's brief: this is a matrix (bands as rows, years 1995-2026 as columns, checkmarks for participation), not a per-event lineup list. Critical caveat: Warped Tour was a touring festival with a different lineup per city/date each year, so the matrix tells you which bands played THAT YEAR somewhere on tour, not who played a given stage/city/date -- there is no stage or set-time data at all, and no way to reconstruct a single day's actual lineup from this table alone. An extraction agent treating a year-column as 'the lineup for that year's festival' would be misrepresenting a touring, multi-city, rotating cast as a single fixed-lineup event.
